A Weekend in Porto Velho (fictional guide for testing)

Harbour Tile Museum is open Tuesday to Sunday, 10am to 6pm, except on public holidays.
It closes for the whole of January for maintenance.

Casa Verde does not take reservations; tables are first come, first served.

Old Pier Market is open daily from 10am to midnight in summer.

We had dinner at Taberna Azul last Friday and got a table without booking.
Taberna Azul recommends booking ahead on weekends.

Lighthouse Tower is closed for renovation until 30 April 2027.
Entry to Lighthouse Tower costs 8 euros.

The view from Hilltop Lift is stunning at sunset.
